Let's go through all 60.

Need understand project Zooniverse? Stories mostly media analysis, citizen science. Atomic criterion. We need assess if story combines features. Many have "and receive related information about them" e.g., ZO-012 identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them. Is that two features? Identify person vs receive info. Independent? They could be independently implementable/testable? Maybe identification and information retrieval/linked info are two features. But within story scope, "identify persons... and receive related information" combines detection and presentation. Atomic violation likely. Need consistency.

It expresses one feature: search/discover music. Maybe "search and discover" may be two? But commonly one feature. Atomic no violation.
